bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
target='theGreatOldDaysofNipponGV'
root='/mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos'
mountpoint -q /mnt/g || exit 71
test -d "$root" || exit 72
if ps -eo args= | grep -F "$target" | grep -E '[p]ython|[u]serbot|[c]ollect|[t]elethon' >/dev/null; then
  printf 'COLLECTOR=PROCESS_PRESENT\nACTION=NO_DUPLICATE\n'
  exit 0
fi
found=''
scope=''
for mode in user system; do
  if [ "$mode" = user ]; then units="$(systemctl --user list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend --plain 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')"; else units="$(systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend --plain 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')"; fi
  for unit in $units; do
    if [ "$mode" = user ]; then body="$(systemctl --user cat "$unit" 2>/dev/null || true)"; else body="$(systemctl cat "$unit" 2>/dev/null || true)"; fi
    if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -Fq "$target"; then
      test -z "$found" || exit 73
      found="$unit"
      scope="$mode"
    fi
  done
done
test -n "$found" || exit 74
if [ "$scope" = user ]; then
  if systemctl --user is-active --quiet "$found"; then printf 'COLLECTOR=UNIT_ACTIVE\nACTION=NO_DUPLICATE\n'; exit 0; fi
  systemctl --user start "$found"
  systemctl --user is-active --quiet "$found" || exit 75
else
  if systemctl is-active --quiet "$found"; then printf 'COLLECTOR=UNIT_ACTIVE\nACTION=NO_DUPLICATE\n'; exit 0; fi
  systemctl start "$found"
  systemctl is-active --quiet "$found" || exit 75
fi
printf 'COLLECTOR=RESTARTED_EXISTING_UNIT\nACTION=RESUMED\n'
